content: Bob is the author of two sci-fi book series: Lunar Foundation (4 books) and Age of Lightships (4 books). He publishes via KDP. Books stored at /mnt/usb_4tb/books/. Uses compressed JPEG images at 200 DPI. Book 4 Waters Horizon had images numbered ch31-ch60 that needed renumbering to ch01-ch30. KDP requires: uncompressed mimetype first in zip, proper NCX with unique chapter titles, guide items, cover-image property, correct media-types. Bob expects thorough investigation and fixing of KDP upload failures.
